ns0:content.ns0:p: Whoever, being a mortgagee, knowingly makes any false statement in any paper, proposal, or letter, relating to the sale of any mortgage, to any Federal land bank; or
Whoever, being an appraiser, willfully over-values any land securing such mortgage—
Shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than one year, or both.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Historical and Revision Notes
ns0:note.ns0:p: Based on section 987 of title 12, U.S.C., 1940 ed., Banks and Banking (July 17, 1916, ch. 245, § 31, seventh paragraph, as added June 16, 1933, ch. 98, § 78, 48 Stat. 272).
Minor changes were made in phraseology.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Amendments
ns0:note.ns0:p: 1994—Pub. L. 103–322 substituted “fined under this title” for “fined not more than $5,000” in last par.
